attchmntText: The Grob Tea Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Grob Tea Company Limited has published its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The results were published in the Financial Express in English and Ekdin in Bengali on 14th November 2026. This publication complies with regulation 47 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The information is also available on the company website at www.grobtea.com. The notice is addressed to the secretaries of the Calcutta Stock Exchange Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The scrip code for the Calcutta Stock Exchange is 017201. The scrip symbol for the National Stock Exchange is GROBTEA. The communication was signed by Neha Singh, the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: The Grob Tea Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome of Board Meeting
voiceSummary: The Grob Tea Company Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 1454.28 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The board also approved inter-corporate deposits and other loans for the financial year 2026-2027. The board took note of a capital expenditure of approximately 16 crore by wholly-owned subsidiary Bazaloni Group Limited for Orthodox Tea Manufacturing Machinery. The board discussed queries raised by the National Stock Exchange regarding a complaint filed by M/s Larica LED Private Limited before SEBI. The statutory auditor issued a qualified conclusion due to the non-provision of current and deferred tax expenses. The total investment in the LED Light business stands at 119.77 lakhs.

attchmntText: The Grob Tea Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: The Grob Tea Company Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a profit before tax of 1454.28 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The board also approved inter-corporate deposits and other loans for the financial year 2026-2027. The board took note of a capital expenditure of approximately 16 crore by wholly-owned subsidiary Bazaloni Group Limited for Orthodox Tea Manufacturing Machinery. The board was apprised of queries raised by the National Stock Exchange regarding a complaint filed by M/s Larica LED Private Limited before SEBI. The statutory auditor issued a qualified conclusion due to the non-provision of current and deferred tax expenses. The total assets as at 30th September 2026 stood at 23109.97 lakhs.

attchmntText: The Grob Tea Company Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: The Grob Tea Company Limited disclosed that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Bazaloni Group Limited, approved a capital expenditure of approximately Rs. 16 crore on 12th November 2026. The funds will finance the installation of Orthodox Tea Manufacturing Machinery at the subsidiary's facility. This project aims to expand manufacturing capacity and strengthen production infrastructure for the tea business. Implementation is expected by 30.04.2027. The expenditure will be financed through bank borrowings by Bazaloni Group Limited. No direct financial contribution is envisaged from The Grob Tea Company Limited. The investment is expected to enhance operational capabilities and contribute to the consolidated business operations of the parent company.

attchmntText: The Grob Tea Company Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
voiceSummary: The Grob Tea Company Limited disclosed litigation against Larica LED Products Private Limited. The dispute concerns a consortium agreement for supplying products to Public Sector Undertakings. Grob Tea initiated arbitration proceedings on 12.11.2025 before the High Court at Calcutta. The Court appointed Mr. Mainak Bose as Sole Arbitrator on 24.09.2025. Grob Tea seeks recovery of Rs. 2,25,67,364/- from Larica LED. Larica LED filed a Statement of Defence and a petition under Section 9 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, before the NCLT, Kolkata, on 21.07.2025. This NCLT petition is pending. Both arbitration and NCLT proceedings are currently pending. The disclosure was made late due to inadvertent omission in internal reporting. The financial impact depends on the outcome of these proceedings.
